hypothesis: If all domestic pigeon breeds descend from Columba livia, breed genomes will nest inside the diversity of C. livia and not group with another Columba species.
pass_criterion: In a whole-genome phylogeny, 100% of sampled domestic breeds fall within the C. livia clade, and no breed groups with another Columba species at bootstrap 90 or more.
fail_criterion: Any domestic breed, or group of breeds, forms a clade with another Columba species that excludes C. livia, at bootstrap 90 or more.
interpretation: 'Descended from the rock-pigeon and its geographical sub-species' means a single wild species of origin. This is tested as monophyly of domestic breeds with C. livia, relative to other Columba and other columbids.

dataset.name: NCBI Datasets Genome: Columba livia (taxon 8932)
dataset.why_it_fits: It lists rock pigeon and domestic pigeon assemblies with downloadable sequence files. Assemblies of other Columba species from the same portal serve as the outgroup comparison.
